h: Priestly Blessing Reaches Every Level of the Soul

p: and they correspond to the six hundred thousand
that there are four orders of number:
and they correspond to the four worlds,
and to the four letters of the Name Havayah;
And there is a further level, yechidah,
which corresponds to the tip of the yud
וּכְנֶגֶד זֶה יֵשׁ עוֹד מִסְפָּר רִבּוֹא
and corresponding to this there is a further number, ten thousand,
is from the world of Asiyah,
and the ruach is from Yetzirah,
and "the soul that You placed in me
but from the left chamber of the heart
a little evil can also rise
to the neshamah that is in the brain;
therefore it is only mostly good.
And the soul of the soul,
for there one cannot corrupt at all.
And this is the matter of the sixty letters
that he brings in for Yisrael to rectify,
are from the level of the nefesh alone,
that the evil be rectified completely,
so that the evil inclination can
And this Aharon the Kohen radiates
to Yisrael from the Holy of Holies,
that the kaf will be closed
the kaf with the yud, keser
and it will be closed forever and ever,
so that the evil inclination cannot enter.
And although there is still existence
of the nations of the world,
אַף עַל פִּי כֵן יִשְׁמוֹר ה׳
that they not come to enter Yisrael at all.
And this is what is said: "and I will bless them."
